new_finding: Persisting close_end_ts can create recursive measurement overhead because the write that records the endpoint itself moves the endpoint.
repair: Operational close_end is now defined as the completion/commit time of the final required terminal-sync write. If only available retrospectively, derive/persist it next invocation without redefining the completed close. Optional measurement writes are excluded from close overhead and reported separately.
impact: This makes COMPLETION_ENVELOPE finite and reproducible and prevents instrumentation from artificially inflating the reserve it measures.
